source: Titles/venues: londontheatre.co.uk musicals list; booking-until and running times: londonboxoffice.co.uk/musicals (both fetched 27 Sep 2026). Blurbs and tags: Claude draft, needs Yuval's review.

audience.teens: Teens and up (check the show's guidance)

shows.title: The Lion King
shows.blurb: Disney’s story of Simba on the African savanna, famous for its puppetry and its opening number.
shows.listen: The Lion King original cast recording

shows.title: Wicked
shows.blurb: The untold story of the witches of Oz and an unlikely friendship, with big sets and bigger voices.

shows.title: Les Misérables
shows.blurb: The sweeping story of Jean Valjean, revolution and redemption in 19th-century France.

shows.title: The Phantom of the Opera
shows.blurb: A masked genius haunts the Paris Opera House. The chandelier, the mask and Lloyd Webber’s famous score.
shows.listen: The Phantom of the Opera original cast recording

shows.title: Hamilton
shows.blurb: America’s founding story told through hip-hop, R&B and pop, by Lin-Manuel Miranda.

shows.title: MAMMA MIA!
shows.blurb: A Greek-island wedding, three possible dads and a string of ABBA hits. Expect to dance at the end.

shows.title: Matilda The Musical
shows.blurb: Roald Dahl’s clever girl takes on Miss Trunchbull, with Tim Minchin’s witty songs.
shows.listen: Matilda The Musical original cast recording

shows.title: Oliver!
shows.blurb: Dickens’ orphan in Victorian London, with classic songs like “Consider Yourself”.

shows.title: The Book of Mormon
shows.blurb: Two young missionaries in over their heads, from the creators of South Park. Very funny and very rude.
shows.listen: The Book of Mormon original cast recording

shows.title: SIX
shows.blurb: Henry VIII’s six wives reclaim their stories as a pop concert. Short, loud and fun.

shows.title: Hadestown
shows.blurb: The Orpheus and Eurydice myth as a folk and jazz concert. Haunting and intimate.

shows.title: Moulin Rouge! The Musical
shows.blurb: A lavish Paris love story set to a mash-up of pop hits, based on the Baz Luhrmann film.
shows.listen: Moulin Rouge! The Musical original cast recording

shows.title: Cabaret
shows.venue: Kit Kat Club at the Playhouse Theatre
shows.blurb: Berlin in the 1930s, staged immersively with the theatre rebuilt as a nightclub. Dark and seductive.

shows.title: Miss Saigon
shows.blurb: A doomed love story set at the end of the Vietnam War, from the writers of Les Misérables.

shows.title: Jesus Christ Superstar
shows.blurb: Lloyd Webber and Rice’s rock opera about the last days of Jesus.
shows.listen: Jesus Christ Superstar original cast recording

shows.title: Billy Elliot the Musical
shows.blurb: A miner’s son in 1980s County Durham discovers ballet, with music by Elton John.
shows.listen: Billy Elliot the Musical original cast recording

shows.title: Into the Woods
shows.blurb: Sondheim tangles Cinderella, Jack, Red Riding Hood and Rapunzel into one story, then asks what happens after happily ever after.
shows.listen: Into the Woods original cast recording

shows.title: RENT
shows.blurb: Young artists in New York’s East Village living, loving and losing, by Jonathan Larson.

shows.title: Avenue Q
shows.blurb: Sesame Street-style puppets with very grown-up problems. Cheeky and very funny.

shows.title: The Devil Wears Prada
shows.blurb: The fashion-world film as a musical, with music by Elton John.
shows.listen: The Devil Wears Prada original cast recording

shows.title: Beetlejuice
shows.blurb: The ghost-with-the-most from Tim Burton’s film, as a loud, darkly funny comedy musical.

shows.title: Paddington The Musical
shows.blurb: The bear from Darkest Peru arrives in London, with songs by Tom Fletcher.
shows.listen: Paddington The Musical original cast recording

shows.title: My Neighbour Totoro
shows.blurb: The RSC’s stage version of the Studio Ghibli film, with large-scale puppetry.
shows.listen: My Neighbour Totoro original cast recording

shows.title: High School Musical
shows.blurb: Disney’s basketball-and-musicals story of Troy and Gabriella, on stage in Wembley.
shows.listen: High School Musical original cast recording

shows.title: Sinatra The Musical
shows.blurb: The life of Frank Sinatra, told through his songbook.
shows.listen: Sinatra The Musical original cast recording

shows.title: Million Dollar Quartet
shows.blurb: The night in 1956 when Elvis, Johnny Cash, Jerry Lee Lewis and Carl Perkins jammed together at Sun Records.
shows.listen: Million Dollar Quartet original cast recording

shows.title: Titanique
shows.blurb: A camp, irreverent Titanic parody told through Céline Dion’s greatest hits.

shows.title: Operation Mincemeat
shows.blurb: The true, absurd WWII plan to fool the Nazis with a corpse and fake papers. A fast, very funny cult hit.

shows.title: One Day
shows.blurb: Emma and Dexter, visited on the same day every year for twenty years. Based on David Nicholls’ novel.

shows.title: Pride
shows.blurb: Based on the film: London gay activists support striking Welsh miners in 1984.

shows.title: Thelma & Louise
shows.blurb: A new musical of the road-trip film about two friends on the run.

shows.title: Martin Guerre
shows.blurb: A rare revival from the writers of Les Misérables: a man returns to his village, but is he really Martin Guerre?

shows.title: Jane Eyre
shows.blurb: Charlotte Brontë’s novel as a new musical, in an intimate fringe venue.

shows.title: Kimberly Akimbo
shows.blurb: The Tony-winning musical about a teenager with a condition that makes her age too fast. Funny and bittersweet.

shows.title: Death Note: The Musical
shows.blurb: A student finds a notebook that kills anyone whose name is written in it. Based on the manga.
shows.listen: Death Note: The Musical original cast recording
